thread:
Samir: Heads-up — found a conversion bug where HF jinja chat_template with an {% include %} nested inside a {% raw %} block ends up merging the assistant fragment into the previous user message after HF->Redwood conversion. :bug:

Lina: ugh ok can you paste a tiny repro?

Samir: sure, minimal snippet (from a real template):
```jinja
{{ system }}
{% raw %}
User: {{question}}
{% include 'signature.jinja' %}
{% endraw %}
```

Samir: signature.jinja contains a short assistant footer:
```jinja
assistant:
Thanks,
Team
```

Samir: After our renderer runs, converted prompt looks like:
```
System: <...>
User: How do I reverse a list?assistant:
Thanks,
Team
```

Samir: note the missing role boundary so the assistant fragment is appended to the user text (no explicit sentinel/role token).

Mike: that explains some weird eval diffs I saw on the quantized run — several odp/qa tests had lower EM and the generated assistant starts mid-sentence. Could be tokenization of the assistant literal inside raw blocks.

Lina: config.json for some HF models maps custom special tokens (e.g., "assistant_token": "<|assistant|>") but our conversion only injects it if roles are parsed. If include sits in raw we treat it as literal and then the post-process that inserts sentinels never runs.

Lina: short-term fix: pre-render includes before raw-block detection so assistant: lines are recognized and replaced with explicit sentinel tokens. Longer-term: make the converter idempotent to literal assistant markers.

Samir: repro attached — I put a tiny repo in /tmp/rw-repro-172999. Reproducer steps in README.

Mike: can you also check if this interacts with quantization? I suspect 4-bit q8_0 shows amplified deltas because tokens shift across the k/v cache boundaries when role separators move.

Samir: good call. I'll run the 4-bit and 8-bit quantized builds on the canary node and post diffs.

EvalBot: scheduled regression job #1729998000 for convo-formatting-suite. Will run EM/F1 + token-diff on both fp16 and q4 runs, post artifacts to /artifacts/1729998000.

Lina: impl notes — two small changes: (1) flatten includes during template pre-render (safe for include-only fragments), (2) if we detect assistant: or lines starting with assistant role inside raw, wrap with explicit sentinel token from config.json rather than relying on later role synthesis. Also add unit that the converted string must contain role sentinels as regex: /<\|assistant\|>|Assistant:/

Mike: tests to add: tokenization roundtrip for the combined prompt (hf tokenizer -> tokens -> detokenize -> our converter) and a kv-cache smoke to ensure no shift.

Samir: I'll open a small PR with the pre-render change + a reproducer test. Requesting review from @Lina and @Mike.

Lina: will review. If it's low-risk we can canary on dedicated tonight. :eyes:

Mike: I'll queue the quantized eval after the PR lands.

Samir: thanks all — pushing repro + initial fix in ~25m. :hammer:
